# Genova — baştan sona uygulama rehberi

3 Ekim 2026 · [WF-017](../briefs/WF-017-linked-delivery-playbook.md)

Bu rehber, onayladığın beş ana hedefi yedi uygulanabilir plana böler. Yeni bir ürün
yol haritası değildir: sıralamanın otoritesi [mobil teslim planı](../mobil-teslim-plani.md),
ürün kararlarının otoritesi [KARARLAR](../../KARARLAR.md), ekran sahipliğinin otoritesi
[MIGRATION](../../MIGRATION.md) olarak kalır. Planın yazılmış olması ürünün bitmesi değildir.

## Nereden başlayacaksın?

Tek giriş noktası bu sayfa; **nerede kaldığımızın tek kısa kaydı [checkpoint](checkpoint.md)**.
Ajan önce gerçek branch/HEAD/değişiklikleri doğrular; ardından checkpoint'teki ilk hazır
işi alır. Her sohbet için yeni plan, yeni çatı veya bütün geçmişi tekrar okuma gerekmez.

| Senin hedefin | Uygulama planı | Bittiğinde elinde ne olacak? |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Tek yayın adayı | [P1 — Adayı sabitle](01-candidate.md) | Dahil özellikler, web/DB/Edge/mobil kaynakları, test kanıtları ve engeller tek aday manifestinde |
| 2. Son dosya değişikliklerinin iOS kontrolü | [P2 — iOS kabulü](02-ios.md) | Aynı adayın dosya akışı ajan tarafından iOS'ta doğrulanmış olacak |
| 3. Uyumlu yayın paketi | [P3 — Yayın ve kurtarma paketi](03-release-package.md) | İncelenmiş, eski istemcilerle uyumlu, geri dönüşü denenmiş kesin yayın paketi |
| 4. Depolama + Android beta | [P4 — Özel depolama geçişi](04-storage.md) → [P5 — Kullanılabilir Android beta](05-android-beta.md) | Drive gerektirmeyen gerçek akış ve kurulu, imzalı beta |
| 5. Tam ürün + iki mağaza | [P6 — Tam ürün](06-full-product.md) → [P7 — Mağazalar ve işletim](07-stores.md) | Bağımsız koroların ticari kullanımı, korunmuş özellikler ve doğrulanmış iki mağaza yayını |

Zincir: **P1 → P2 → P3 → P4 → P5 → P6 → P7**. Her plan önceki planın
kanıtlı çıktısını alır; sonundaki devir, sonraki planın başlangıcıdır. Engellenen bir
aşama görünür kalır. Gerçekten bağımsız hazırlık yapılabilir ama o kapı atlanmış sayılmaz.
Örneğin mağaza hesaplarının salt-okunur durum kontrolü erken yapılabilir; yayın yapılamaz.

## Vibe coding çalışma kuralı

1. **Bir aktif sonuç seç:** “Mobil uygulamayı bitir” değil, “aynı adayda iOS dosya
   iptali indirme başlatmıyor ve koro değişimi eski bağlantıyı reddediyor” gibi ölçülebilir iş.
2. **Mevcut brief'i kullan:** ilgili açık brief'e en fazla üç sonraki adımlı iş kartı ekle.
   Gerçekten farklı bir sonuç için şablondan yeni brief aç. Her küçük düzeltmeye yeni belge açma.
3. **Uygula ve kanıtla:** önce odaklı kontroller, sonra değişen katmanın gerekli kapıları.
   Android/iOS testini ajan yapar; otomasyon engeli sana manuel test ödevi olarak dönmez.
4. **Dürüstçe kapat:** zorunlu FAIL veya NOT RUN varsa iş açık kalır. Kaynak hash'i,
   tarih, ortam ve test sınırı kanıta yazılır; aynı kaynaklı test gereksiz tekrarlanmaz.
5. **Devret:** yalnız sahip olunan değişiklikleri commit'le; kod ve belgeleri ayır.
   Checkpoint, kısa handoff ve activeContext bağlantılarını güncelle. Sonraki hazır işe geç.

Bir plan birçok brief içerebilir; planın tamamı tek büyük kod değişikliği değildir.
İki sonuçsuz denemede aynı işlemi tekrarlamak yerine nedeni ve yöntemi değiştir.
Disk/build/temizlik sınırları [mevcut kontrollerden](../mobil-teslim-plani.md#bounded-execution-and-resource-controls)
alınır. Bu rehber yeni bir ajan sistemi veya test altyapısı kurmaz.

### Aynı veya yeni sohbete yapıştırılacak mesaj

```text
Genovakorist'te docs/teslim-rehberi/README.md ve checkpoint.md üzerinden devam et.
AGENTS.md, docs/agent-handoff.md, memory-bank/activeContext.md ve ilgili brief'i
projenin okuma sırasıyla oku. Branch/HEAD, dirty dosya sahipliği ve mevcut kanıtı
doğrula; önceki sohbetin tamamının taşındığını varsayma.

Checkpoint'teki ilk hazır iş için tek ölçülebilir hedef ve en fazla üç sonraki adım
yaz; mevcut onaylı kapsam içinde uygula, gerekli testleri kendin yap. Bana Android
veya iOS manuel test adımı verme. Aynı kaynaklı geçerli kanıtı koru; değişen sınırı
yeniden doğrula. Zorunlu FAIL/NOT RUN varken tamamlandı deme.

İş bitince kapsam içi commit, kanıt ve kısa checkpoint bırak. Sonraki planın giriş
koşulları ve mevcut yetki uygunsa oradan devam et. Canlı işlem için önce kesin hedef,
sürüm, veri etkisi, maliyet, kurtarma ve mevcut yetkiyi eşleştir; eksik olanı sor.
Ürün kapsamını, kalıcı WebView ekranlarını veya güvenlik kurallarını sessizce değiştirme.
Jev'i gerekli semantik sorularda kullan; sır/özel veri gönderme, model yanıtını test
veya yetki sayma. Sohbet analizi gerekirse arındırılmış metni doğrudan Jev'e aktar;
tam sohbetleri kendi bağlamına yükleme. Bana sonuç, kanıt sınırı, maliyet ve sıradaki
somut adımı Türkçe bildir.
```

Branch değiştirdiğinde ajan aynı manifestin kaynaklarını bulamıyorsa checkpoint'i körlemesine
uygulamaz: eksik commit/çalışma ağacını belirler. Otomatik reset, toplu cherry-pick veya
uzak main'e toplu push yoktur. Yarım işin sahipliği çözülmeden ikinci yazıcı başlamaz.

## Test ve yayın gerçeği

| Kanıt | Neyi gösterir? | Neyi göstermez? |
|---|---|---|
| Birim/typecheck/build | Tanımlı kod davranışı ve derlenebilirlik | Gerçek kullanıcı akışı veya canlı sürüm |
| Gerçek yerel Auth/RLS/Edge + tarayıcı | O kaynak/ortamda servis ve arayüz birleşimi | Hosted ayar/provider/cihaz kabulü |
| Sentetik emülatör/simülatör akışı | O platformun çalıştırılan senaryosu | Fiziksel cihaz, canlı tenant verisi, mağaza dağıtımı |
| Canlı hedefte doğrulanan paket | Belirtilen sürümün belirtilen uçları | Eski tüm istemciler veya mağazada erişilebilirlik |
| Kurulu imzalı beta | Tanımlı beta kullanıcı yolculuğu | Tam özellik kapsamı ve iki mağaza yayını |
| Mağaza kurulumu + işletim kontrolü | P7'nin son kabulü | Sonsuza kadar hatasız çalışma |

Kaynak/dependency/config değişirse etkilediği kanıt yeniden açılır. Belge değişikliği
tek başına iki platformu yeniden derleme nedeni değildir. Yeni bir yayın paketinde
kaynak aynı olsa bile hedef ortam ve dağıtım doğrulaması ayrıca gerekir.

## Kararlar ne zaman sorulacak?

Kesinleşenler tekrar sorulmaz: RN/Expo, Supabase, özel R2 yönü, Android-first,
operatör destekli ilk açılış, beş ücretsiz üye, ek üye ücretlendirmesi, ilk sürümde
manuel fatura, sonraki çevrimiçi istekte erişim iptali, kardeş siteye dokunmama,
eski notları koruma ve ajan tarafından QA.

| Karar | En geç hangi işten önce? | Şimdiki yaklaşım |
|---|---|---|
| İlk beta grubu ve gerçek dağıtım hedefi | P5 davet/dağıtım | Grup sırası kararlaştırıldı (#34): önce mevcut korodan küçük grup, sonra ikinci bağımsız koro. Kesin alıcılar ve dağıtım kanalı ayrıca netleştirilecek |
| Anotasyon ortak düzenleme, silme/geçmiş, çakışma, kaydedilmemiş iş | P6/B2–B3 | 023'teki dört karar paketi yeniden doğrulanıp birlikte sorulur; sessiz son-yazan-kazanmaz |
| Push taşıyıcısı ve hedef bildirim kapsamı | P6/C2 sağlayıcı entegrasyonu | Mevcut Expo-first önerisi karar değildir; güncel maliyet/uyumlulukla sunulur |
| Ek üye fiyatı, dönem, davetli/pasif üye hesabı | P6/D2 ücret/limit uygulaması | Ücret varsayılmaz; beş ücretsiz ve manuel fatura korunur |
| Saklama, hesap/koro silme, son şef devri, çevrimdışı içerik politikası | P6/D3 ve çevrimdışı kitaplık | Geri döndürülemez işlemden önce açık karar; indirilmiş bayt geri alınamaz |
| Yayıncı kimliği, mağaza hesapları, bölgeler ve yayın kapsamı | P7; salt-okunur hazırlık daha erken | Gerçek erişim/eksik doğrulama kaydedilir; parola sohbette istenmez |

Bunlar toplu peşin anket değildir. Ajan yalnız yakındaki işi değiştiren kararı sorar;
yanıt gelmezse bağlı iş bekler, bağımsız hazırlık sürdürülebilir. Canlı işlem yetkisi
tercih sorusundan ayrı, kesin paketle değerlendirilir; önceki geçerli izin korunur.

## Jev nerede kullanılacak?

[WF-016 analizi](../reports/2026-10-03-jev-conversation-direction-audit.md) temel alınır;
17 sohbetin taraması her aşamada tekrarlanmaz. Aday-kapsam çelişkisi, arındırılmış
hata sınıflandırması, `rg` ile daraltılmış kaynak seçimi ve beta geri bildirimi kümeleri
anlamlı kullanım alanlarıdır. Jev metin/kod yazan ana ajan değildir; yapılandırılmış
yargı verir ([TypeSafe açıklaması]([URL_REMOVED])).
Olasılık kesinlik veya yayın izni değildir ([güven açıklaması]([URL_REMOVED])).

Yeni çağrıdan önce güncel skill/docs, amaç, arındırılmış paket, model, çağrı/token bütçesi,
anahtarın geçerli kullanım kapsamı ve durma koşulu belirlenir. Sonuçta kaynak kimliği,
dağılımlar, uyuşmazlıklar, gerçek kullanım ve tahmini/faturalanmış maliyet ayrılır.
Bu rehberin Jev incelemesi ve ek maliyeti WF-017'de ayrıca kayıtlıdır; önceki denetimin
maliyeti kendi kaydında kalır. Tenant/rol/RLS, test geçişi ve kabul kararı deterministik
kanıta dayanır. Sahibin bu turdaki yönü: ajan, kendi işlerinde de anlamlı semantik
inceleme fırsatlarında Jev'i kullanır; mekanik kontrolleri gereksiz AI çağrısına çevirmez.

## Tam kapsamın kaybolmadığını nasıl takip edeceğiz?

| Mevcut teslim paketi | Bu rehberde sahibi |
|---|---|
| A1–A3, C1, 090: mevcut okuma ve platform kanıtı | P1 envanter; P2 eksik iOS; P3 güncel uyumluluk |
| A4, D6: yayın/güvenlik/kurtarma | P3 hazırlık; P4 gerçek hedef kabulü; P7 final yenileme |
| D4: Drive çıkışı | P4; P5 gerçek kullanım kabulü |
| A5/M1, 004/010 açık cihaz/davet satırları, D1 | P5; iOS/fiziksel kapsamın kalan kısmı P7'de açık izlenir |
| B1–B5 + kalıcı çevrimdışı kitaplık | P6; donanım/stylus/arka plan ölçümleri P7 final matrise bağlı |
| C2–C5, 051 kabulü dahil | P6; beta açıkta sunduğu alt kümeyi P5'te kanıtlar |
| D2–D3, WF-013/F05/F08/F09/F13/F14 | P6; mağaza uyumunun final kabulü P7 |
| WF-013/F01–F04/F06/F07/F12 | P1/P3 kaynak-güvenlik eşleme; P4 canlı; kalan F12 incelemesi D6/P7 |
| WF-013/F10/F11: migration/10–100 koro ölçeği | P6, release gate P7 |
| D5: hosting | Mevcut hosting korunur; ölçülmüş engel veya yeni karar olmadıkça taşıma N/A |
| E1–E5 | P1 kapsam; P5 beta; P7 tam aday/dağıtım/işletim |

Bu tablo modül özellik envanterinin yerine geçmez. Hiçbir açık özellik sırf betada
yok diye silinmez; yeni brief, ilgili eski kabul satırına geri bağlanır.

# P1 — One reviewable release candidate

[Guide](README.md) · [State](checkpoint.md) · Next: [P2](02-ios.md)

## Contract

One outcome: an exact, internally consistent candidate manifest that another agent
can reconstruct without reading prior chats. Entry: WF-016 source audit and current
checkout. This is the decomposition of delivery queue source reconciliation, not a
bulk-main release or a requirement to rewrite working code. Own execution in 090's
candidate work card; use a new brief only for a genuinely distinct bounded repair.

Read [090](../briefs/090-private-file-ticket-revocation-contract.md),
[WF-013](../briefs/WF-013-multi-tenant-remediation-plan.md), the input reports in
[checkpoint](checkpoint.md), MIGRATION and exact relevant source. No conversation rescan.

## Ordered work

1. Verify repository/branch/HEAD/dirty ownership and read-only remote identity. Inspect
   candidate refs and manifests. Confirm the actual served web revision separately when
   available; do not substitute GitHub main for deployment proof. Record unknowns.
2. Construct one candidate ID under `docs/reports/090/` with the schema below. Map
   client calls to required SQL/Edge/functions/config. Separate minimal compatible
   promotions from unrelated accumulated work. No copy/worktree merely for cleanliness.
3. Review inclusion/omission and test provenance. Resolve contradictions locally;
   reuse unchanged accepted Android checks by hash. Hand one manifest to P2, and a
   dependency/old-client inventory to P3. Do not rename missing evidence as accepted.

## Mandatory manifest fields

| Section | Fields |
|---|---|
| Identity | candidate ID/date, checkout HEAD/tree, owned diff hash if any, exact component refs/trees; clean construction instructions |
| Components | web, embedded WebView, RN Android/iOS, shared contracts, ordered SQL file IDs/checksums, Edge function source/config identities, lockfiles/toolchain |
| Features | each current route/action → included in beta / retained for final / explicitly excluded by owner; dependencies and reason |
| Runtime boundary | native/WebView/Edge ownership; no new Next API for native logic; auth/choir/role and private-file contracts |
| Target | observed existing release and date, intended project/domain/build channel, unknown deployment facts explicitly marked |
| Evidence | exact source hashes, test date/environment, PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN, reuse rationale, invalidated checks |
| Release blockers | severity, exact failing/unrun criterion, owner plan/brief, next smallest action; no unrelated full-product feature as beta blocker |
| Recovery | preflight requirements, rollback/forward-repair pointers, old-client support and external authority status |

Multiple component SHAs may compose one candidate; do not falsely assign one SHA to
different tested trees. A later code/config change versions the manifest and reopens
affected evidence. A documentation-only commit need not invalidate product hashes.

## Acceptance and handoff

P1 is complete only when every mandatory component, exposed feature and dependency
is resolved to a source identity or an explicit later **environment** gate. An unknown
required source dependency blocks P1; missing hosted verification belongs to P3/P4.
Candidate source identity can be frozen while runtime acceptance remains pending.

Required evidence: refs/hashes verified, feature inventory reconciled, unchanged
Android pins matched, all known blockers assigned, local links and diff clean. Use
the existing brief's mandatory evidence table. Product tests are required only if
product code changes, not to validate this inventory. Self-review is labelled as such.

Output: manifest + acceptance record + code/document commit identities as applicable.
Update checkpoint to P2 only after acceptance. No push, deploy, DB or provider write.
Rollback affects owned planning changes only; no resetting others' work.

# P2 — Current iOS private-file acceptance

[Previous P1](01-candidate.md) · [State](checkpoint.md) · Next: [P3](03-release-package.md)

## Contract

One outcome: the latest candidate's protected-file user flow is proved on iOS by
the agent, with platform-specific limits explicit. Entry: accepted P1 manifest and
same-source Android evidence. Execution remains in [090](../briefs/090-private-file-ticket-revocation-contract.md).
Do not reopen unchanged Android scenarios just to repeat them; source/config changes
that affect Android do require focused regression.

Read the [Android full-flow acceptance](../reports/2026-10-03-android-full-share-flow.md),
P1 manifest, existing iOS tooling/source and resource controls. Prior iOS acceptance
predating the changed PDF/cleanup flow cannot close this result.

## Ordered work

1. Inspect installed simulator/automation tools and existing scripts. Record free
   disk, projected peak, owned targets and cleanup. One heavy build/runtime. Prefer
   supported Computer Use; use authorized existing simulator automation if necessary.
   An unavailable tool is an automation blocker, not a request for owner manual QA.
2. Build/run the exact guarded candidate against bounded synthetic local services;
   execute the matrix below with fresh UI and network/file evidence. No Google account,
   real recipient, real choir mutation or replacement memory-only secure store.
3. Fix only reproduced defects within 090's paths; rerun affected checks and final
   mobile gates. Record source identities, platform/build and limits, verify guard-off
   product behavior, clean owned output, hand the accepted candidate to P3.

## Required scenarios

| Scenario | Observable acceptance |
|---|---|
| Cancel consent | Return to profile; zero file GET/HEAD/provider bytes caused by cancellation |
| Confirm and read | Nonblank intended PDF, exact fixture size/hash, visible pages 1 and 2 |
| Share and return | Actual iOS share surface opens; dismiss without recipient; reader remains usable |
| Close | Reader closes; ephemeral file removal proved, not inferred from unmount |
| Active A → B | Switch using actual AuthStore while A profile is active; old A URL's next GET/HEAD denied; no provider read; old UI/cache cleared |
| Expired/revoked authority | Recoverable expired authorization follows the approved path; valid denial never bypassed or retried with broad credentials |
| WebView boundary | No persistent bearer/refresh credential leak; allowed lease/renewal, teardown and relevant storage checks tied to exact WebView candidate |
| Normal build | Inspection/test paths fail closed or are absent when guard is off; ordinary sign-in reachable |

Capture attempt status without rewriting earlier failures. The synthetic dispatcher
does not establish hosted RLS or full Next routing; those are P3/P4. A simulator is
not physical-device/stylus/background-audio proof; remaining hardware rows stay open.

## Acceptance and handoff

Every row is recorded in 090 with date/revision/command/environment/evidence/limit.
New RN code: `npx tsc --noEmit && npm test` in `apps/mobile`; shared/web/build changes:
root `pnpm check`, plus affected runtime gates. Do not add a general test framework.
If no source change, reuse valid source gates and run the missing iOS integration.

Required failures keep P2 open. After two unsuccessful approaches, record cause/new
method; do not loop builds. Output: iOS evidence and updated candidate manifest with
precise invalidations. Remove owned build/runtime artifacts after final dependent
checks, preserve existing toolchains/user data. Acceptance advances checkpoint to P3;
it does not close whole 090/R1 or authorize a hosted release.

# P3 — Compatible, reviewed and recoverable release package

[Previous P2](02-ios.md) · [State](checkpoint.md) · Next: [P4](04-storage.md)

## Contract

One outcome: an exact actionable release package with independently reviewed
compatibility and demonstrated recovery, before any candidate promotion. Entry:
P1 manifest + accepted latest iOS/Android boundaries. Use 090/R1 and the existing
[R2 release runbook](../private-r2-release-runbook.md), not a second deployment system.

Read [R1's failed compatibility boundary and backup limits](../reports/2026-10-02-hosted-revocation-r1-recovery-rehearsal.md),
the candidate browser/profile reports, [WF-013](../briefs/WF-013-multi-tenant-remediation-plan.md)
and the current runbook. DB/Edge inspection uses the correct project's approved
connector and applicable skills. Do not inspect or change the detached sibling site.

## Ordered work

1. Trace all exposed beta routes to exact backend dependencies. Audit browser-only
   APIs in shared/native paths and minimum backports. Verify old-open tab, refreshed
   web, installed old mobile, new mobile and mixed web/Edge versions. Preserve the
   signature-only legacy-reader defect as a regression; updating Edge alone failed.
2. Refresh exact target/read-only preflight and prepare a fresh protected backup
   and isolated restore under applicable authority. Prove ordered migrations and
   old/new client negative tests against the recovered state. Inventory exclusions
   (Vault/queues/object bytes/settings/Auth) and cover each required recovery layer.
3. Arrange an actually independent review of the precise manifest/diff, then rehearse
   rollout/forward repair with failure checkpoints. If no independent reviewer is
   available, record NOT RUN and the missing review; self-review/Jev is not a substitute.
   Hand the concrete package and exact remaining authority to P4.

## Required release rows

| Gate | Required evidence |
|---|---|
| Compatibility | Actual Next route/middleware + Edge/Auth/RLS integration, all five file families, current/old clients, stale URLs and session/role/member changes |
| Database | Exact ordered SQL hashes; fresh restore, roles/grants/policies and negative tenant tests; incompatible down paths prohibited |
| Recovery | Backup timestamp/target/access protections; restore result; per-layer data/object/config recovery and explicitly bounded loss window |
| Application order | Expand compatible DB → compatible Edge → repaired web/readers → supported mobile → activation; any necessary intermediate version separately tested |
| Revocation | Existing URL's next online GET/HEAD denied after authority loss, across old/new clients; already downloaded/in-flight bytes excluded honestly |
| Review | Named independent reviewer/run, exact candidate hash, findings addressed or release-blocking; self-review retained separately |
| Dependency/security | Exact lockfile triage, secret/config and authorization negatives; unresolved relevant risk is explicit, no blanket suppression |
| Operation packet | Each write's target/project/account, revision, data/resource scope, cost, automatic deployment effects, check and recovery/stop command |

A restore that omits object bytes cannot claim file recovery. Git revert does not
restore rows, roles, files or installed binaries. Do not restore actorless tickets
or the known inactive-membership defect as a convenient rollback.

## Acceptance and handoff

Use required PASS/FAIL/NOT RUN rows in the owning brief. P3 closes when package-level
review/rehearsal gates pass and every external step is executable or explicitly
awaiting its target-specific authority. **Actual deployment tests remain P4**, not
falsely PASS here. Preserve prior permissions; ask only for missing scope with the
completed packet. No generic “approve everything” request substitutes for that match.

If dependencies change the candidate, return its affected scope to P1/P2 without
rerunning unrelated checks. If a deployed stage later fails, stop dependent rollout,
execute only the rehearsed authorized recovery and reopen this gate as needed.
Output: one reviewed manifest/runbook/recovery/evidence set; no bulk push of local main.

# P4 — Compatible live services and private-storage cutover

[Previous P3](03-release-package.md) · [State](checkpoint.md) · Next: [P5](05-android-beta.md)

## Contract

One outcome: the declared beta's real file readers and writers use private storage
without requiring Drive, with reconciliation and recovery proved. Entry: accepted
P3 package and exact applicable hosted/provider/copy/cutover authority. Preparation
does not itself authorize these mutations. Keep DB/Auth/Realtime/Edge on Supabase;
no hosting or Railway rewrite. Use the [existing runbook](../private-r2-release-runbook.md).

Owners: 090 hosted revocation, [077](../briefs/077-repertoire-mp3-r2-batch-3.md) and
the existing copy/activation briefs. Each bounded batch keeps its own acceptance;
do not combine the whole storage migration into an unreviewable write.

## Ordered work

1. Verify target/source/config/backups immediately before each authorized action.
   Promote only P3's compatible dependency chain and verify each actual destination.
   A failed DB/Edge/client step stops dependent activation. Confirm ordinary web
   users and supported old clients still operate safely.
2. Refresh real inventory without exposing private bytes in reports. Reconcile
   the dated 42 copied objects and remaining 49 MP3; derive exact pending batches.
   Resume approved copies idempotently with size/hash/ownership evidence. 077's
   ten-object packet is a historical proposal, not permission to copy today's matches.
3. Reconcile mappings and activate by file family, verifying real readers **and
   writers**, then withdraw old public access under separately matched authority.
   Retain source objects/notes and recoverable mapping history. Complete declared
   cutover checks before handing the live service manifest to P5.

## Required matrix

| Area | Exit evidence |
|---|---|
| All retained file families | Every inventory record reconciled by tenant/resource/version; copied/active/error/skipped rationale; no unaccounted required object |
| Reads | Correct MIME/size/checksum, PDF rendering, audio Range/seek, HEAD, expiration/renewal and denied tenant/role/session; private object not anonymously readable |
| Writes | New uploads/submissions/media complete atomically into intended private backend; interrupted/retried upload safe; no Drive-only writer left behind |
| Cutover | Current mapping/flags and actual deployed versions recorded; old/new clients supported or safely refused according to package |
| Authorization | Previously issued URL next-request refusal; wrong tenant, inactive member, changed role and stale context cannot fetch bytes |
| Old access | Old public links/ACL actually withdrawn or release remains blocked for that family; copying or hiding a link is not revocation |
| Recovery | Tested mapping/config recovery or forward repair without reopening known security defects; original files retained |
| Cost/operations | Measured object/egress/request footprint, real cost estimate versus <=$5/month preference, discrepancy surfaced before new spending |

No real conductor note or Drive object is deleted by this plan. Sibling website and
retained tables are outside scope. No key, private object URL or raw user file is
sent to Jev; only redacted metadata/questions if semantic assistance is useful.

## Acceptance and handoff

P4 requires actual target evidence, not a local mocked provider. Record date,
deployed revisions/function versions, inventory hashes/counts, authority scope,
verification and recovery for each step. Required failures keep cutover open.
Use fresh provider docs/skills and target-specific tests when executing; do not
invent current pricing, policies or provider capabilities from this plan.

Output: deployed compatibility manifest + complete storage reconciliation + access
withdrawal/recovery evidence. Update P1 identity if exact release composition changed.
P5 receives this backend baseline; later target drift invalidates dependent beta
checks. Remove only owned disposable outputs; preserve protected backups.

## Common adversarial acceptance

- Two unrelated choirs and one account in both; URL/row/object/Realtime topic guessing;
  wrong choir, revoked role/membership, suspended account and expired session.
- Permission change during in-flight read/write; two users save/invite/upload together;
  uniqueness/seat reservations/idempotency and recovery from ambiguous commit.
- Deleted choir/member/resource; last chef; shared vs personal records; missing or
  malformed metadata and unknown annotation types. No data-loss fallback.
- Multi-client mixed revisions; app process death/offline/reconnect; queued operations
  cannot replay into a different tenant. Next-request online revocation remains fixed;
  already downloaded bytes are not remotely erasable.
- 10 then 100 synthetic choirs: measured query/page/request count, latency/memory and
  tenant boundary; agreed thresholds and environment stated before asserting scale.

Not every row needs rerunning for every tiny change; map each to its owning brief
and run at coherent integration boundaries. RN/web/DB/Edge gates follow AGENTS.
CI execution, hosted fixtures, real email/notifications and destructive operations
retain their own target scope. Reuse existing tools, do not build a compliance framework.

## Linked stages

1. **P7.1 — Store-ready full candidate.** Verify publisher identity/account access,
   territories, privacy/terms, actual SDK/data/permission disclosures, deletion entry
   and web resource, review access, listing assets/accessibility and commercial-model
   assessment. Confirm new backend/schema/client compatibility and recovery through

2. **P7.2 — Signed two-platform acceptance.** Produce exact reproducible Android/iOS

Each stage uses its own bounded work card or brief when the observable outcome

## Required final gates

| Gate | Completion evidence |
|---|---|
| Complete scope | P6 matrix has no unapproved missing feature; permanent WebViews remain by decision, not unfinished native promises |
| Security/lifecycle | Cross-tenant/role/old-client/file and deletion/retention/seat boundaries proved; relevant independent review findings resolved |
| Android and iOS | Exact signed source/build/config identities; installation/update/relaunch, permissions, accessibility and promised hardware behavior |
| Store compliance | Current official/account-specific checklist, actual app disclosures and assets reviewed; billing/legal decisions recorded, not AI-assumed |
| Publication | Separate submission, approval and actual availability/install verification for each store; failures remain visible |
| Recovery | Fresh backup/restore and configuration/object scope; compatible rollback/forward repair for installed clients; incident drill |
| Operations | Named support owner/channel, crash/incident triage, backup cadence, supported-client policy, provider budget/usage check and first maintenance exercise |

## Final handoff and stop

Deliver release manifest, accepted evidence, actual store references/build IDs,
known nonblocking issues, operational runbook and prioritized maintenance backlog.
No recurring monitor is created unless the user asks for one. Publication does not
authorize announcements to people or indefinite background account activity.

If one store is pending, report one-store availability and the other exact blocker;
do not close P7 or the two-store goal. If physical proof is missing, do not promote

scope. At actual completion checkpoint becomes RELEASED, with evidence links rather
